zh.text: 根據前日本央行理事的說法，日本銀行很可能在明年中之前再加息三次至2%，達到1993年以來未見的水平。

en.text: The Bank of Japan will likely raise its benchmark interest rate three more times to 2% through the middle of next year, taking it to a level not seen since 1993, according to a former BOJ board member.

zh.text: 將CPI和PPI映射到PCE的分析師預計10月整體價格同比上漲3.8%，核心價格上漲3.2%（月環比0.29%）。按照這個讀數，過去12個月中有9個月核心價格至少上漲0.26%。

en.text: Analysts who map the CPI and PPI into the PCE expect overall prices rose 3.8% in October from a year earlier, with core prices up 3.2% (0.29% on the month). With that reading nine of the last 12 months would show core prices rising at least 0.26%.
